config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

config.label: Gutendex catalog API base URL, used for search and popularity browse when the local catalog mirror cannot answer
config.description: Gutendex catalog API base URL, used for search and popularity browse when the local catalog mirror cannot answer. Leave blank for the public instance.

config.label: Project Gutenberg content mirror serving the /cache/epub tree: book text, the bulk catalog archive, and per-book catalog records
config.description: Project Gutenberg content mirror serving the /cache/epub tree: book text, the bulk catalog archive, and per-book catalog records. Leave blank for gutenberg.pglaf.org.

config.label: Path to the local catalog-mirror SQLite file
config.description: Path to the local catalog-mirror SQLite file. Leave blank to use the per-user default that gutenberg-mcp-server mirror init builds.

config.label: Cron schedule for an in-process catalog-mirror refresh, e
config.description: Cron schedule for an in-process catalog-mirror refresh, e.g. 0 4 * * *; on an empty mirror the first run is the full harvest. Leave blank to disable.
